profile.name: Shariq Mehmood
profile.title: SEO Specialist
profile.tagline: On-page, off-page and technical SEO for Shopify and WordPress brands in e-commerce and local business.
profile.bio: SEO Specialist with over a year of hands-on experience across on-page, off-page, and technical SEO for Shopify and WordPress websites in e-commerce and local business. Skilled in keyword research, meta optimization, schema markup, and off-page link building, with hands-on experience in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Business Profile optimization, and technical SEO audits to drive organic growth.
profile.photoAlt: Portrait of Shariq Mehmood, SEO Specialist

experience.title: Junior SEO Specialist
experience.summary: Ran research, on-page, technical and off-page SEO across client projects and new site builds, reporting on performance throughout.
highlights: Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and semantic keyword clustering to guide content strategy and identify high-intent opportunities
Optimize on-page content, including meta titles, descriptions, and product/blog content, to improve organic visibility and rankings
Manage Google Business Profiles and monitor performance via GA4 to strengthen local visibility and traffic insights
Implement schema markup, URL redirects, and page speed improvements to resolve technical SEO issues and improve site health
Build backlinks and execute off-page campaigns, including directory listings, guest blogging, Web 2.0 publishing, and social sharing, to grow domain authority
Contribute to full SEO builds for newly-launched websites and deliver performance reports tracking progress across projects

projects.name: ASG Consulting
projects.subtitle: RICS-regulated building surveyors in Liverpool & the North West
projects.whatTheSiteDoes: A RICS-regulated building surveying and construction consultancy operating from Liverpool across Merseyside, the Wirral, Cheshire, Manchester and the wider North West. The site sells twelve specialist services — HomeBuyer (RICS Level 2) and full Building Survey (Level 3) reports, commercial surveying, measured building surveys, building pathology and defect diagnosis, high-level drone surveying, housing disrepair reporting, dilapidations, employer's agent work, asset management and structural engineering. It runs a dedicated service page per discipline, an 'Areas We Cover' page, published case studies, a Learning & Resources blog, and an embedded Google review feed. It trades as Absolute Services Group Ltd.

projects.name: RX Furnace Industry
projects.subtitle: Global industrial heat-treatment furnace manufacturer
projects.whatTheSiteDoes: The export-facing site for Dongguan Rexin Machinery Technology Co., Ltd., a Guangdong-based industrial furnace manufacturer founded in 2008. It carries a deep equipment catalogue — tempering, annealing (including stainless-steel bright annealing lines), brazing, nitriding, carburizing and quenching, hardening, sintering and solution-treatment furnaces, plus ammonia crackers and furnace accessories — organised into category and sub-category pages, with industries-served, technical support, specifications, FAQ and news sections. It serves buyers across Europe, the Americas and Asia through localized Spanish, Arabic, Russian, Indonesian and Vietnamese subdomains.

projects.name: Fiddlebling
projects.subtitle: Humor-first merch store for fiddlers and violinists

Beyond the storefront it publishes a musician-focused blog and maintains a fiddle camp directory, giving the site editorial surface area well beyond product pages.
